templates.useCase: Recurring AICPA Town Hall recap newsletter — repeating video-highlight blocks (320x181 image + bold title + description), each linking out to a timestamped recording.
templates.toneNotes: Short, punchy block descriptions. No long paragraphs per block — treat each block like a highlight reel entry, not an article.
templates.ctaPattern: Bold purple pre-header CTA at the very top; each content block's image/title is itself the link (no separate button per block).

templates.useCase: Recurring AI-focused news roundup — 4 numbered article modules, each with a 'What's new:' / 'Why it matters:' two-part structure.
templates.toneNotes: Denser and more analytical than AICPA Town Hall — full paragraphs per section, font-weight 400 (not the usual 300), navy (#0f206c) bold section headers.
templates.ctaPattern: Pre-built bracket-style 'Read more →' button per article (cyan #41b6e6, left/right PNG brackets) — this is protected template structure, not the standard Button:/Link: system. Only href/text may be swapped, and only when explicitly instructed.

templates.useCase: Default single-message email for CPA.com-branded sends — plain header image, intro + body paragraph(s), no promo styling. Use when nothing else fits.
templates.toneNotes: Plain, professional, no special emphasis styling beyond standard body/bold/link rules.
templates.ctaPattern: Standard Button:/Link: system CTA (solid purple default) — no pre-built buttons in this template.

templates.useCase: Default single-message email for the Domains.CPA sub-brand — same skeleton as CPA.com General, but with 'Domains.CPA' wordmark in the footer bar instead of 'CPA.com/'.
templates.toneNotes: Same as CPA.com General — plain, professional, no promo styling.
templates.ctaPattern: Standard Button:/Link: system CTA — no pre-built buttons in this template.
templates.note: Lacks section marker comments entirely (no START/END FOOTER, no PREHEADER/HEADER) — footer detection should fall back to the 'Black Footer Bar' markers for this template. See brand-guide.json sectionMarkers.knownGaps.

templates.useCase: Co-branded email featuring one external partner logo alongside CPA.com's — commonly used for partner webinar/workshop promotion.
templates.toneNotes: Same body copy rules as General, plus mentions the partner by name in the intro when relevant.
templates.ctaPattern: Standard Button:/Link: system CTA; footer wordmark link uses '{{Partner}}' merge token (e.g. 'CPA.com/{{Partner}}').

templates.useCase: Co-branded email featuring two external partner logos alongside CPA.com's — used when a send involves two partners at once (e.g. a joint webinar).
templates.toneNotes: Same as CPA Partner Single, adapted for two partners in the same send.
templates.ctaPattern: Standard Button:/Link: system CTA; footer wordmark link uses '{{Partner}}' merge token.
